description: This file contains styling functions for a collapsible side navigation component in a React project, including styles for items, icons, and text within the sidenav.

methods.name: collapseItem
methods.description: Generates styles for a collapsible sidenav item based on theme and owner state.

methods.name: collapseIconBox
methods.description: Provides styling for the icon container within the sidenav item.

methods.name: collapseIcon
methods.description: Returns style object for the icon color based on active state.

methods.name: collapseText
methods.description: Generates styles for the text label in the sidenav, including responsive opacity and font weight.
